description: SynthWatch monitor registry. Each entry binds a stable `id` (the key SynthWatch monitors reference) to a Playwright script in monitors/. The SCRIPT (the how) lives here; the MONITORING CONFIG (interval, locations, alerting, enabled) lives in SynthWatch's DB bound to this id. SynthWatch discovers scripts by reading this manifest after syncing the repo. Add a monitor by adding a .spec.ts under monitors/ AND an entry here; CI validates the two stay in sync.

monitors.name: Meals2Go: cheese pizza carry-out cart (Buffalo/McKinley)

Non-sensitive by decision: the guest session token is short-lived and protects nothing.

monitors.name: Wegmans B2C login — InfoSec on-demand unblock test
monitors.description: ★ InfoSec ON-DEMAND TEST INSTRUMENT (ships DISABLED; Craig fires it from the allowlisted egress) — NOT a cron health monitor. Logs into wegmans.com B2C (myaccount.wegmans.com, #signInName/#password → SelfAsserted, policy B2C_1A_…WithPhoneVerification) with the InfoSec-sanctioned Vercel bypass header as the Akamai+Vercel discriminator (allowlisted IP + header = past the bot wall). CLASSIFIES the outcome: COMPLETED / OTP_GATED / BOT_BLOCKED (Akamai blocked DESPITE header+allowlist — actionable) / INCONCLUSIVE_HEADER_DROPPED (header didn't ride the B2C nav — our bug) / OTHER. The header is injected host-scoped to myaccount.wegmans.com by the spec (the runner's PROTECTED_BYPASS_HOSTS omits that host — the runner gap the spec compensates for). sensitive=true: real test-account login; redact_patterns + the built-in denylist scrub Bearer/JWT/B2C-session values from trace_signals. Green only when the login COMPLETES.

monitors.name: Wegmans commerce PREVIEW: search → product (pre-prod regression)
monitors.description: ★ PRE-PROD REGRESSION CHECK (ships DISABLED; Craig enables after one verified-clean on-demand run from the allowlisted egress). REUSES the prod search-product spec unchanged (S2 host-rewrite, zero spec churn): the runner rewrites the spec's hardcoded rewrite_from_origin (https://www.wegmans.com) to this check's target origin (https://preview.commerce.wegmans.com) at the route layer, and injects the Vercel bypass header + x-vercel-set-bypass-cookie for the preview host (#215). environment=staging → EXCLUDED from prod slo/mttr/trust (API #188), INCLUDED in region-health/egress, so it can never pollute prod fleet numbers. ★ ROUTE-MISMATCH RISK (Craig-accepted): search-product targets the www.wegmans.com storefront app, not the commerce app — /shop/search may not exist on the commerce preview; a red here is expected until validated on-demand and is why it ships disabled. sensitive=false: anonymous search/browse, no login/Bearer/PII. Requires runner PRs #215 + #216 deployed before it runs.

monitors.name: Wegmans: full authenticated pickup shopping flow
monitors.description: ★ FULL AUTHENTICATED PICKUP SHOPPING FLOW (SENSITIVE; ships DISABLED; on-demand validation first). Labeled steps: login → search+add milk/eggs/bread/bananas → verify 4 in cart → checkout as PICKUP → timeslots render + selectable → select a slot (SAFE: Craig-confirmed no capacity hold until order placement; the monitor NEVER places the order) → clear cart → logout. TEARDOWN (clear-cart + logout) runs in a finally so a failed run never leaves a dirty cart / live session for the next run. CONCURRENCY = option 3 (offset cron per region — dashboard-owned config: eastus2 :00/:30, centralus :15/:45, NOT westus2) + a HARD in-spec run-cap so a slow run can't bleed into the next same-region tick and corrupt the shared account. REUSES proven selectors (login+LOGGED_IN_AFFORDANCE_RX from b2c-login-test #52/#60; search+first-result from search-product; redaction/diag from #57/#59). ★ NET-NEW authenticated selectors (add-to-cart/cart/checkout/pickup/timeslot/clear-cart/logout) are resilient but NOT yet live-verified — each failing step emits a structural OTHER-DIAG so the FIRST sandbox fire verifies/corrects them. sensitive=true: real login; redact_patterns + the built-in denylist scrub Bearer/JWT/B2C-session. ★ DO NOT SCHEDULE until every step is proven green + clean-teardown across several on-demand fires and Craig sets cadence/region posture.
